events.title: Recovery proposed
events.detail: Payments service enforces strict currency validation, rejecting legacy currency strings. This causes checkout to fail with 500 errors. The ledger schema 2 compatibility advisory permits disabling strict_currency_validation in payments without rolling back. This action is supported by current policy and evidence. All affected services (checkout, payments, storefront) are impacted via dependency chains. Notifications and inventory remain unaffected and are healthy.
